# [Hold] Marketing Team Meeting
Date: 2026-09-08 | Duration: 53.189998626708984m

## Summary
The team agreed to expand advertising beyond the US into Europe because Europe represents a significant share of the sales pipeline and competitors are targeting overseas markets, while budget limitations may require phased expansion. The 5.1 release is tentatively planned for Tuesday, pending engineering’s final go/no-go decision, with a release blog, EU data residency content, social posts, sales enablement, training, Slack announcements, recorded office-hours videos, in-app updates, and follow-up emails. Event planning includes assigned copy leads, shipped swag, an October executive dinner with 16 registrants, a Berlin experimenters meetup on October 15, automated CFP scanning, and brand agency finalist selection. Demo improvements, customer and competitive one-pagers, a support capacity page, and MCP webpage updates are progressing. Website work includes improved blog featuring, a partners page, performance reviews, Plausible and GA4 comparison, restored Docs tracking, and delayed cookie consent. GitHub discussions, segmented videos, chatbot research, customer interviews, and G2 review outreach will support feedback and engagement.

## Keywords
Product release, marketing campaign, 5.1 launch, EU enablement, customer engagement, website analytics
